description: Prepare Gate Verify tx_checkin for x402 (EVM exact / EIP-3009 only): returns tx_checkin.message (64-hex digest) and x402_payment_required_b64 without signing. Flow: 1) this tool 2) Gate Verify tx_checkin with returned tx_checkin fields 3) dex_tx_x402_fetch with same url/body/headers, checkin_token, and the same x402_payment_required_b64. If x402_payment_required_b64 is omitted, performs one HTTP call and requires HTTP 402.

headers.description: Optional JSON object of request headers

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

x402_payment_required_b64.description: Optional: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header base64; when omitted, one outbound request is made and must return 402

name: dex_tx_x402_checkin_preview
